title: Houston names 'the Hill', a telepathic chat room for non-speakers

tellings.quote: coined this term this the talk on the hill which was this telepathic chat room where non-speakers can tune in and communicate with each other

plain: A young man named Houston, one of a group of people who cannot speak, is said to have named "the Hill," a telepathic chat room where non-speakers tune in and talk to one another with their minds. The filmmaker Ky Dickens, who made a documentary about these non-speakers, tells Michels this as something Houston and others, including people named Akil, John Paul and Libby, described to her in Atlanta in 2023. If true, it would mean these people share a hidden mental meeting place.
